body.name: Audit log management process maintained
body.description: Audit logs are captured, retained and reviewable.
body.detail: The audit log is append-only in application code and queryable through a filtered, paginated route.
observations: No route updates or deletes an audit row.
Indexed on timestamp, actor and action so a review is practical, not theoretical.

LIMIT, STATED: append-only is enforced by the application, not the database. A holder of direct database credentials could still edit it; the ingested-record hash chain is what defends the evidence itself.
